prompt:
Which operating power plants in Harris County, Texas with an operating capacity of at least 100 MW are within 500 meters of FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area (including any inside it)? Give their names.

Your working directory: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/workspace/claude-haiku-5.5/Q6_1

output.method: From the HIFLD Power Plants layer I kept Harris County, TX plants with STATUS = OP and OPER_CAP >= 100 MW, giving 18 plants. From the NFHL flood hazard polygons I kept SFHA_TF = 'T' (Special Flood Hazard Area), reprojected both layers to EPSG:32615, buffered each plant by 500 m, and selected plants whose buffer intersects the SFHA; features inside the SFHA are included because they also intersect it. Five plants qualify: Deer Park Energy Center, Bayou Cogen Plant, Greens Bayou, T H Wharton, and Channel Energy Center LLC.
